name: Neural Model Training for Atlas Baking
definition: A 2D surfel rasterizer with a hash-grid and MLP appearance model, used to train a neural model from which the texture atlas is baked. One configuration is used for every scene.
summary: Neural Model Training for Atlas Baking defines the hyperparameters and optimization schedule to train a neural appearance model for generating a residual texture atlas, distinguishing itself by providing the specific configuration required before the baking step.
